subject: The admin console is NOT wired to UpdateManager.js / version.json, so an arbitrarily stale console tab can keep writing old data shapes indefinitely - index.html and dashboard.html have the version check, console.html does not
description:
Surfaced 2026-09-17 by the adversarial reviewer while checking whether a hosting deploy can defeat a stale admin tab during the QA-02 flag-storage migration (taskboard 401). It cannot.

MEASURED: _app/components/UpdateManager.js + _app/config/version.json exist and are referenced by _app/index.html and _app/dashboard.html. _app/admin/console.html references neither - no version check, no forced reload.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND QA-02: the admin console is the platform's highest-authority writer. It creates tournaments, challenges, classes and teams, and it is the single writer of several data shapes (e.g. tournaments/{id}/private/config at console.html:11157, the challenge docs at :11169). A tab left open across a deploy keeps writing the OLD shape with no warning to the operator and no signal anywhere, until something downstream reads it and fails - which for the tournament flag migration would have meant a challenge with public crypto fields and no private counterpart, created after the migration was declared complete.

Ordinary student pages get the version check; the one surface where a stale write does the most damage does not.

FIX DIRECTION (not decided): wire console.html to UpdateManager the way index.html/dashboard.html are, and consider whether the admin console should HARD-block writes on a version mismatch rather than merely prompting - a prompt the operator dismisses mid-event is the same as no check. Worth a vote if it changes write behaviour.

RELATED: taskboard 401's fix now carries a standing reader-side invariant (ctfSubmitFlag refuses loudly when a challenge has no flagSecrets entry) precisely because a stale tab cannot be prevented by deploy ordering. That mitigates the tournament case only; every other shape this console writes is still exposed.
